name: Raven-PPT
description: Builds a PowerPoint deck: turns the user's material into a .pptx, reviewing every rendered page before it publishes. Use when the deliverable the user asks for is a .pptx -- a presentation, slides, a keynote, or a deck template all count. A .pptx named only as source material is not such a request.
owns: owns decks and slides. Do not build the deck yourself.
